learning_outcomes.text: Proper implementation of specific fundamental knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry, in the field of electrical engineering.
Use of fundamental knowledge of electrotechnics.
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components.
Acquire basic knowledge about the main phenomena that occur in the study of electrical materials.
Develop basic theories and methods of physics, chemistry, suitable for the field of electrical engineering.
Appropriate theoretical notions necessary for laboratory activity.
Establish knowledge and practical skills of carrying out assembly schemes.

syllabus_topics: Anorganic and organic chemistry. Chemical bonds.
Crystalline corps. Defects of crystalline networks
Energy bands of the electron in crystal
Technical and technological properties of electrotechnical materials
Work protection rules specific to electrical equipment. Getting the basics of the study of electrical materials.
Dynamic study of brushes for electric machines
Determination of dielectric rigidity in electro-insulating oils
Determination of dielectric rigidity in solid dielectrics
Determination of dielectric rigidity in gaseous dielectrics
Study of viscosity of liquid dielectrics
Determination of the characteristic of varistors.
Study of the influence of temperature on photovoltaic cells.
Evaluation of laboratory activity. End of the situation Evaluation of laboratories and their support; Remaining lab recovery.

assessment_methods.method: Written, oral or online examination for the course
Knowledge assessment test for laboratory work

assessment_rules: For a grade of 5, all subjects must be treated to minimum standards. For grades greater than 5, all subjects must be treated proportionally according to the scoring scale. All laboratory work must be carried out, which is a condition to enter the exam.
